name: RENTALS
tagline: Works your Facebook Marketplace rental leads from enquiry to showing
description: Aimed at landlords who lose good tenants to a slow reply. It sits on your Marketplace ads, answers the people who get in touch in a tone matched to the way you write, gets viewings into the diary, and chases the ones who go quiet rather than letting them drift off.
author: HandsomeHenry6
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
